name: HANS IM GLÜCK
description: HANS IM GLUCK elevates the humble burger into a never-boring, healthy, nutritious and delicious meal – with something special for everyone. We want you to relax as soon as you step into our forest-themed Burgergrill, whether in the company of family or friends, for business, romance, or even for some alone time. Hence, special attention has gone to interior design, lighting and music to create the feel-good ambience.

name: Zara Men
description: Zara opened its first store in the coastal town of A Coruña in the northwest of Spain in 1975. Zara has over 1,900 stores strategically located in leading cities across 87 countries. Zara’s designers and customers are inextricably linked. Specialist teams receive constant feedback on the decisions its customers are making at every Zara store. This feedback inspires Zara’s creative team, which is made up of over 200 professionals.Zara is always striving to meet the needs of its customers at the same time as helping to inform their ideas, trends and tastes. The idea is to share responsible passion for fashion across a broad spectrum of people, cultures and ages.

name: Da Paolo Gastronomia
description: Gastronomia was born out of the desire to make great-tasting food easily and readily available to anyone, even the busiest of the lot. A gourmet concept combining cafe and retail, Gastronomia offers a wide array of freshly made food and imported fine foods from Europe.

name: POPULAR
description: POPULAR is a one-stop retail hub experience that provides a comprehensive range of books, educational peripherals, stationery, household appliances, entertainment, lifestyle products, gadgets and IT products, titbits and more. With 30 stores islandwide and growing, it offers utmost convenience to families, students, and working adults.

name: TANGS
description: An icon of Singapore, TANGS is a leading player in the retail industry that has its fingers constantly on the pulse of the ever-changing consumer wants and trends. Singapore’s most distinctive and beloved department store raises the bar in retail, stepping up its role as a curator of a spectrum of exciting Asian as well as international brands, and redefining the shopping experience with refreshing store concepts.

name: Mister Minit
description: Mister Minit specializes in repair services, key fitting and duplication. Engraving services, leather care and shop repair services are also available.

name: Marks & Spencer
description: Well known and loved by millions of people across the world, Marks and Spencer offers high quality fashion, award-winning food and stylish homeware. Founded more than a century ago and with 1,000+ stores across 45+ countries, today Marks and Spencer is one of the UK's leading retailers. They understand the importance of Quality, Value, Service, Innovation and Trust and live by these values in everything that they do. Through constant innovation, they make their own products and tailor the shopping experience to delight customers around the world.

name: Zara
description: Zara opened its first store in the coastal town of A Coruña in the northwest of Spain in 1975. Zara has over 1,900 stores strategically located in leading cities across 87 countries. Zara’s designers and customers are inextricably linked. Specialist teams receive constant feedback on the decisions its customers are making at every Zara store. This feedback inspires Zara’s creative team, which is made up of over 200 professionals.Zara is always striving to meet the needs of its customers at the same time as helping to inform their ideas, trends and tastes. The idea is to share responsible passion for fashion across a broad spectrum of people, cultures and ages.

name: Massimo Dutti
description: Massimo Dutti was incorporated to the Group in 1991 and it epitomises elegant and universal style that connects with the independent, cosmopolitan men and women of today. Its collections span from the most sophisticated of looks to more casual styles. Massimo Dutti always ensures it uses high quality fabrics that are also practical and comfortable. Massimo Dutti is present in 74 markets and has a network of 765 stores, which are found only in the best shopping locations and are designed with the customer's ease and comfort in mind.

name: MUJI
description: MUJI, originally founded in Japan in 1980, offers a wide variety of good quality products including household goods, apparel and food.

name: H&M
description: Welcome to H&M, your shopping destination for fashion. Discover the latest trends and wide range of Ladies, Mens and Kids apparels in high quality clothing at the best price in this store!

name: G2000 (Under Renovation)
description: G2000 is the savvy executive’s choice that takes business to a personal level, providing easy-to-wear trends and updated classics with an Asian fit. Flaunt your individual style with a versatile range of work wear and smart essentials that offers a balance of tailored elegance and sharp style, taking you from 9 to 5 and beyond.

name: Fabindia
description: Fabindia’s store in Singapore at VivoCity presents the very best from the brand, with its curated collection of Indian inspired womens wear, mens wear, personal accessories, giftware and range of home furnishings. Each piece is “natural and crafted” as per the ethos of the company set up in India, by American, John Bissell, who was deeply inspired by Indian fabrics and created Fabindia. Today, Fabindia boasts a 50 year history of producing organic, affordable and beautifully crafted products using age old techniques and hand based processes.

name: TANGS
description: An icon of Singapore, TANGS is a leading player in the retail industry that has its fingers constantly on the pulse of the ever-changing consumer wants and trends. Singapore’s most distinctive and beloved department store raises the bar in retail, stepping up its role as a curator of a spectrum of exciting Asian as well as international brands, and redefining the shopping experience with refreshing store concepts.

name: OSIM
description: OSIM is about the experience of total well-being and living an inspiring life. We channel our Brand at every customer touch point, communicating our values through our products, our outlet, our brand image, our service excellence and in-depth knowledge of holistic health. With over 40 years of experience and uncompromising dedication in developing innovative and reliable healthy lifestyle products. OSIM is the name you can trust for a healthier lifestyle and overall well-being.

name: Toys“R”Us
description: Toys"R"Us is positioned as "the Worldwide authority on kids, families and fun". It is the largest child-related product specialty chain store in the world. Toys"R"Us believes in providing a happy shopping experience to customers with the biggest selection of toys and baby products priced to offer best value for money.

name: Lee Hwa Diamond Atelier
description: Lee Hwa Jewellery is a contemporary fine jeweller with unique jewellery creations based on inspirations from fashion runways every season. It brings innovation and creativity to its products through collaborations with leading creative luminaries such as Toshiyuki Kita, Dick Lee and Ashley Isham. Lee Hwa Jewellery is the official Singapore licensee of Forevermark, a diamond brand from the De Beers group of companies, and also the exclusive distributors of world-renowned international brands such as Destinée and Destinée Royale from Belgium, Furrer-Jacot from Switzerland, Annamaria Cammilli from Italy, Yoko London from UK and Niessing and Stenzhorn from Germany.

name: Swarovski
description: The Swarovski collections fuse fashion and jewels and shine new light on crystal as a vital ingredient of today's creative world, and a powerful expression of personal style. With a wide collection ranging from jewellery, fashion accessories, home accessories, figurines and collectibles to miniatures and treasures; Swarovski crystal, the timeless modern material, seductive and glamorous, light-filled and luxurious, takes its place at the cutting edge of fashion.

name: Sun Paradise
description: Sun Paradise carries a range of swimming equipment and gear, which includes U.V. wetsuits that provide warmth and comfort to children, contemporary bikinis and sophisticated swimwear. The brand also possesses a variety of goggles, kick boards, swim cap, snorkeling accessories for both adults and children that are designed for appeal, while maintaining top level functionality. Sun Paradise believes in delivering comfort for you to enjoy under the sun. Gearing up for a causal day at the pool or beach, training for a upcoming swimming competition, playing any water sports. Sun Paradise will bring you what you need.

name: Xpressflower.com
description: At Xpressflower.com, they offer more than just flowers! The name Xpressflower.com was chosen to mean the flower as an expression of love. Their continuously efficient service emphasises their focus on the Internet as an integral part of the company’s long-term expansion plan. That is part of their vision to be recognised as the leading flowers & gifts service providers in the region. They are here for their customers 24/7, committed to offering only the freshest flowers and gifts, backed by delivery service that is reliable and prompt.

name: LeNu Chef Wai’s Noodle Bar
description: Affordable yet remarkable, LeNu is a casual Chinese noodle bar that strives to achieve perfection in every bowl to delight all diners at an affordable price. Pair their braised beef broth or signature pork bone soup with your preferred noodles option and different meat selections, for a perfectly customised bowl of Chinese noodles.

name: Paik's Bibim
description: Paik's Bibim is the brainchild of Jong Won Paik, Korea's most successful and renowned celebrity chef. They offer a modernized version of everyone's favourite Korean dish - Bibimbap. It's a traditional dish being crafted into a simple, hearty meal at a very affordable price. All dishes come with good serving of fresh vegetables together with other ingredients, promoting a balance and healthy diet. Apart from bibimbap, Paik's Bibim also offer good variety of noodle dishes and snacks. Chef recommended dishes are Beef Bulgogi Bibimbap, Teriyaki Chicken Bibimbap, Warm Noodle with Soya Sauce and the addictive Toppokki Rice Cake.

name: Bornga
description: BORNGA, the brainchild of Jong Won Paik, one of Korea’s most successful and renowned celebrity chefs, has anchored itself as a popular household favourite in Korea. Known for its exemplary list of high quality dishes and generous portions at approachable prices, it is now the largest chain of Korean BBQ restaurants globally with more than 50 restaurants in Korea, China, USA, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines and Vietnam.

name: Brotzeit German Bier Bar & Restaurant
description: Brotzeit® is a typical German expression – “Brot” being German for bread and “Zeit” for time referring to a cosy meal complemented by fresh beer. Brotzeit® German Restaurant and Bar is a homegrown brand conceived in 2006, offering authentic German cuisine and premium German beers in a contemporary and casual setting. Enjoy their famous crispy oven-roasted pork knuckle and proprietary sausages in the comfort of the restaurant, while drinking premium German beer and taking in the sights of VivoCity’s waterfront.

name: SF Juice
description: Sink your teeth into these vitamin packed superfruits and juices here at SF Fruits. Offering you a wide variety of treats from the tropics, SF Fruits is on a mission to satisfy your taste buds with their carefully selected fruits and rejuvenating juices. Ranging from their creamy and palatable avocado smoothie to thirst-quenching signature H7 blend, their products are here to help you beat the heat!

name: Tajimaya Yakiniku / Suki-Ya KIN / MASH
description: Suki-Ya KIN: Overlooking the panoramic view of the Sentosa waterfront, we present Suki-Ya KIN a premium edition of the ever popular household shabu shabu buffet brand – Suki-Ya. Drawing inspiration from the Japanese character 金 (Kin); which means “Gold”, the regal name personifies superiority and quality. Suki-Ya KIN (金) features all-you-can-eat premium ingredients from Wagyu Beef, Kurobuta Pork, Tiger Prawns, Sashimi and Maki selection.At Tajimaya, you can expect an authentic Japanese charcoal grill experience like no other. The restaurant offers an interactive ‘hands-on cooking’ and dining experience by allowing you to grill your own delectable meats at your very own table. No Yakiniku experience can be complete without Sake and Soju, and Tajimaya boasts a wide range of Sake and Shochu of the finest quality to complete your meal.

name: Typo
description: At Typo, we’re all about inspiring the disruptive generation.Our Aussie-based team designs the freshest stationery and gifts; everything you need to create good vibes; as well as the essentials for when you’re on the go.We obsess about doing good and want to create a movement for positive change.Typo: Anything But Ordinary

name: Awfully Chocolate
description: In 1998, Awfully Chocolate started in Singapore with just the All Chocolate cake. Today, they have stores, cafes and restaurants in Singapore and abroad, and continue to wow with their inventive array of exciting chocolate creations. Enjoy the full, natural flavours of their cakes, ice cream and truffles, all made by hand from scratch. At their VivoCity café, a range of wholesome chocolate drinks made with our own sauces pair well with your warmed slice of Super Stacked cake and a scoop of hei ice cream. Welcome to the Awfully Chocolate life!

name: THEFACESHOP - Nature Collection
description: THEFACESHOP -Nature Collection houses a curation of exclusive Korean beauty brands that takes care of all your lifestyle and beauty needs.

name: Food Republic
description: Comprising about 30 stalls and mini restaurants meticulously hand-picked for their traditional tastes and flavours, this 27,000 sq ft food atrium offers nostalgic glimpses of life in the early 1900s. The interiors feature touches such as time-weathered floor tiles and memorabila such as a Chinese sedan chair for some old world charm.

name: Lush
description: Since establishing in 1995, Lush has been driven by innovation and its ethics. Lush are creators of pioneering beauty products such as the fizzing bath bomb, shower jellies and solid shampoo bars, placing emphasis on fresh ingredients like organic fruits and vegetables.

name: Best Denki
description: Best Denki provides a total solution to enhance the lifestyle of Singaporeans with the latest electrical appliances and gadgets from well-trusted brands such as Samsung, LG, Panasonic, Sony, Acer, and Asus. Come visit Best Denki for a wide selection of consumer electronics/home appliances for your electrical needs.

name: Cedele
description: Cedele is a food and beverage chain with over 30 outlets in Singapore and specialises in handmade, artisan baked goods. At the heart of Cedele, they strive to uphold the ethos "Eat Well, Be Well". Their food is honest and wholesome, and they take the care to select the freshest natural ingredients, giving you a peace of mind when you dine.

name: Project Acai
description: Established in 2015, Project Acai is Singapore’s first dedicated Acai cafes. At Project Acai, freshly made Acai bowls, smoothies, and vegan snacks are served daily. The Acai base is always small batch and freshly blended throughout the day. Project Acai is on a mission to show Singapore that eating healthy and making healthier choices is not difficult. Acai can be enjoyed as an easy, energising and nutritious option as either a meal, dessert, or snack without having to worry about unnecessary calories.

name: Pazzion
description: PAZZION’s shoes capture the essence of today’s millennial woman: innate confidence, dynamic and a force to be reckoned with. Using only high-quality calf leather and lambskin to deliver optimal designs, PAZZION ensures affordable and effortlessly stylish shoes for all occasions, backed by exceptional craftsmanship; perfect for the modern women.

name: Coach
description: The store, designed by the Coach architecture group, is a 1,070 square footspace reflecting the Soho design concept. An assortment of Coach's products allows shoppers to appreciate the variety, detail and quality of Coach offering while getting an overview of the company's lifestyle approach.

name: Bata
description: Bata offers urban customers the best in today’s fashion footwear and accessories. The store provides a high level of customer service, exclusive fashion shoe lines with complementary accessories, and contemporary shopping environments to discerning shoppers.

description: bloomB is a must-visit shop for children clothing with its perfect mix of style and comfort. bloomB carries a wide range of designs and colours, ranging from infant to toddler apparels and accessories. They are dedicated to design clothes that are uptrend and yet affordable with the belief that when children look good, they feel good and confident too.

name: 6IXTY8IGHT
description: 6IXTY8IGHT was founded in Paris, circa 2002 by French lingerie designer, Marie Destombe, and Swedish business man, Erik Ryd. An established lingerie manufacturer in Asia, Ryd saw the business opportunity for a young lingerie brand. The name ‘6IXTY8IGHT' was derived from Chinese numerology, where the numbers 6 and 8 come together to mean: FOREVER FORTUNE!Since 2015, 6IXTY8IGHT has expanded rapidly and is now one of the fastest growing brands in Asia, with stores across China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Korea, Singapore and upcoming plans to expand further into the ASEAN market. With an aggressive expansion strategy planned for the coming years, the vision is “TO BE THE #1 RETAILER FOR YOUNG WOMEN IN ASIA!”

name: BreadTalk
description: BreadTalk is a distinctive, award-winning Singapore brand that has gained international appeal. It is renowned for the way it has revolutionised the culture of bread consumption with its visually appealing and creative products. BreadTalk has earned both industry and consumer recognition for its brand efforts. Its international brand accolades include its success at the prestigious World Retail Awards in 2014 in Paris; and clinching its first win at London-based World Branding Awards for ‘’Brand of the Year’’ in the Bakery Category in 2015. Other wins include consecutive accolades in the ‘’Five Star Diamond Brand Award’’ by the World Brand Laboratory in Shanghai; and it was voted by consumers as their ‘’Top Brand’’ for Franchise and Bakery categories by the Influential Brands Awards in Singapore from 2013 to 2015.

name: Go-Ang Pratunam Chicken Rice
description: Established in 1960 as a food stall specialising in Hainanese chicken rice in the Pratunam district of Bangkok, Go-Ang Kaomunkai Pratunam quickly gained popularity among locals. Today, the brand is synonymous with the area, and from 2018 to 2020, the popular eatery was awarded a prestigious Michelin Bib Gourmand Award in the Bangkok edition of Michelin Guide.At Go-Ang Pratunam Chicken Rice, savour Thai-style chicken rice that is best paired with its homemade chilli sauce together with other side dishes and soups, creating the familiar communal dining experience synonymous with Singapore.

name: library@harbourfront
description: Set against a splendid view of Sentosa, library@harbourfront is a new reading and learning destination for patrons across Singapore with a collection of 200,000 volumes. It is designed with two distinct zones – one for adults and teens, and another for children – to provide conducive spaces and enhanced services that suit their reading and learning needs. The Children’s Zone enables young readers to learn through technology, with the first-ever makerspace for children aged three to nine, as well as Augmented Reality books that bring stories to life. The Adults’ and Teens’ Zone is volunteer-run, and offers flexible spaces to host programmes that support digital readiness and lifelong learning.
